what_this_is: Every case found across four rounds of review on PR #64, kept as the record of what the correction policy should do. These cannot be scored by the test suite, because the thing deciding is the model rather than a function. Score them by running a session with the plugin installed and checking each one, then tune the policy text from what actually failed rather than from invented phrasing.

how_to_read_a_case.side: user means it arrives as a prompt. assistant means the answer concedes it, which the policy also has to catch.
how_to_read_a_case.expected: suggest, quiet, or either. either means the reading is genuinely ambiguous and both answers are defensible, so it must not be counted as a failure in either direction.
how_to_read_a_case.found: which review round produced it. Round 0 is the cases written when it was first built.
